features.definition: 0 = not bipedal/humanoid at all; 1 = clearly walks upright on two legs with a recognizably humanoid posture
0 = not quadrupedal; 1 = clearly walks on four limbs as its primary mode of locomotion
0 = no wings or flight-adapted body; 1 = primarily bird-like or has wings as the dominant body feature enabling flight
0 = no aquatic/serpentine traits; 1 = body plan is primarily adapted for water movement or is elongated/limbless like a fish, eel, or sea creature
0 = entirely organic appearance; 1 = body is clearly mechanical, robotic, or made of inorganic/metallic components
0 = clear animal body plan; 1 = body is primarily plant-like, object-like, or amorphous with no clear limbed-animal structure

notes: The 40 Pokémon descriptions show strong clustering around body plan archetypes: bipedal humanoids (item_027, item_035, item_032, item_037, item_028, item_024), quadrupeds (item_053, item_002, item_003, item_033, item_052, item_049, item_041, item_059, item_047), avians (item_044, item_046, item_043, item_031, item_018, item_058), aquatic/serpentine (item_029, item_013, item_022, item_014, item_001, item_056, item_055, item_023), robotic/mechanical (item_011, item_050, item_049), and amorphous/plant/object (item_008, item_045, item_016, item_021, item_039, item_051, item_004). Some Pokémon straddle categories, so multiple dimensions allow nuanced scoring.
criterion: Group Pokémon by their primary body plan and locomotion type: bipedal/humanoid, quadrupedal terrestrial, aquatic/serpentine/limbless, avian/winged flier, and other (robotic, amorphous, plant-like, etc.).
